help.title: Emergency help
help.survival: To start survival mode, press **Start survival mode** on the home screen, or open a terminal and type `aictl mode survival`.
help.drive: Plug in the AI-ARK drive, then press **Import from drive** in the app, or type `aictl ark import`.
help.library: If the library button doesn't work, open `http://127.0.0.1:8888/library/` in the browser.
help.codes: A code like `LAI-SVC-001` comes with a one-sentence fix. Do what it says. The manual *Troubleshooting* has more.
help.lastResort: If nothing works: restart the computer and wait 2 minutes.
